(Medea gazes at the sky, repeatedly turning an object over in her hands. When %s comes into view, she offers a warm smile.)
strings.이리스 님과 이야기는 잘 끝났나요? 설화에서 맛있는 음식도 드셨겠죠?: Did your conversation with Lady Iris go well? I trust you enjoyed a good meal at the Snowflower Inn, too?
strings.물론이죠. 안 그래도 많이 배고팠었거든요. 그런데 무슨 일로 부르셨어요?: Of course. I was very hungry. What did you want to see me about?
I want to tell you something about my past that Lady Iris does not know.
strings.바이스의 악행을 다시 이야기하는 것이 괴롭긴 하지만, 이조차도 이리스 님: It pains me to speak of Weiss' atrocities again, but Lady Iris must know even this.
That knowledge will help her save many lives.
strings.안녕하세요, 제나. 잘 있었어요?: Hello, Jenna. Have you been well?
strings.저는 언제나 이곳에서 잘 지내고 있답니다. 영지 밖을 나갈 수 없는 건: I'm always doing well here. Though I do wish I could leave the estate...
strings.오라버니도, 모험가님도 자주 찾아오시고, 이리스 님께서도 가끔 말을 걸어: My brother and you visit often, Lady Iris speaks to me sometimes, and the Algea here play with me. I'm happy.
...That ominous presence and the unpleasant feeling in the estate are clearly gone now...
You and my brother must have resolved something very serious.
Hello, Lady Jenna. Lord Ziskad has told me about you. It's a pleasure to meet you. I am...
strings.그 귀…. 혹시 메디아…님이신가요?: Those ears... Are you... Lady Medea?
strings.네, 오라버니와 같은 초인이시란 건 알고 있어요. 그리고 오래 전에 뵌: Yes. I know you're a Champion like my brother. And I feel as though we met long ago. Oh, perhaps I only saw you from a distance.
I'm sorry I didn't recognize you...
It's all right. What brings you here, though...
strings.(제나가 메디아의 손에서 희미하게 빛나고 있는 뭔가를 발견한다.): (Jenna notices something glowing faintly in Medea's hand.)
strings.호숫가 안쪽에서 비슷한 물건을 본 것 같아요. 제가 어떻게 할 수 없는: I think I've seen something similar farther along the lakeshore. I couldn't do anything with it, so I left it there...
Thank you. It will help both me and Lady Iris.
Will it? Then bring it to me when you find it. Perhaps...
I'm sorry. Because of my people...
It wasn't your fault, Lady Medea. That witch was responsible.
Then we'll be back. Come, %s. Let's find the Tear of Illusion by the lake...
Yes, thanks to you. And to %s.
strings.제 덕분이라고 하기엔 호숫가 끝에서 너무 잘 보여서…. 그러면 이제 어떻: I can hardly take credit. It was easy to spot at the far end of the lakeshore... What do we do now?
strings.절 따라오세요. 그곳에서 이야기하시면 돼요. 아마도 제가 할 수 있는 이: Follow me. You can talk there. I may have something to tell you as well.
strings.이곳의 호숫가에선 더는 탁한 느낌이 들지 않군요. 연옥의 힘과 함께 바이: The murky presence no longer hangs over this lakeshore. Weiss vanished, along with the power of Purgatory...
strings.다신 억울하게 죽어가는 사람들이 없겠죠?: No more people will die unjustly, will they?
We'll all do everything we can to prevent it.
strings.(메디아가 조심스레 손 안에 있던 환영의 눈물을 바라본다.): (Medea carefully studies the Tear of Illusion in her hand.)
strings.예전에 모험가님이 지스크 영지에 오시고 제 진실에 대해 알게 됐을 때 조: When you came to the Zisk Plains and learned the truth about me, Adventurer, a few more memories returned to me.
strings.칼리 족 이야기에요. 이렇게 메디아 님이 모험가님과 함께 온 건 아마도: They concern the Kali tribe. Lady Medea coming here with you is probably no coincidence.
No, these things do not happen by chance. Now, then...
strings.(메디아가 환영의 눈물의 일부를 떼내 바닥에 떨어뜨린다. 떨어진 조각은: (Medea breaks off a piece of the Tear of Illusion and drops it. Beneath the tip of her staff, the fragment turns to powder and scatters.)
strings.(그리고 멀리 흐릿한 그림자의 형상으로 누군가의 모습이 떠오른다.): (In the distance, someone's form emerges as a hazy shadow.)
(I never thought I'd see this scene again. But it seems a little different from before...)
strings.은혜도 모르는 것!! 너희 일족이 데이모스 교단과 왕국에 고통받지 않도록: Ungrateful wretch! All I did was help your people escape persecution by the Deimos Order and the kingdom... Why must we...
strings.영주님께서 저희 일족을 도와주신 건 감사합니다. 허나 당신의 왕국은 하지: I am grateful for your help, my lord. But your kingdom has done something it should never have done.
You made contact with another 'witch.' And she must have demanded something from you.
strings.하울 왕국이 마녀의 힘을 원하는 것…. 그렇다면 영주님께서 저희를 도와주: The Kingdom of Howl seeks a witch's power... In that case, your efforts to help us have come to nothing...
You have ended up helping Weiss, who tried to kill my people...
Can you truly not give up being a 'witch'?
strings.어쩔 수 없습니다. 제가 살고 일족이 살고…. 그리고 저와 같지만 조금은: I have no choice. For my own survival, for my people's... And for the child whose fate is like mine, yet somewhat different...
strings.…그 아이, 메데이아는 대체 몇 번이나 다시 눈을 뜬 거지? 제나가 돌봐: ...That child, Medeia. How many times has she opened her eyes again? When Jenna looked after her...
You knew? Then I cannot let you live...
strings.이 마녀!! 내가 널, 끝까지 죽어서도 저주할 것이다!! 처음부터 가까이: Witch! I will curse you to the end, even in death! I should never... never have let you... near us...
strings.저희 일족이 살려면 이 아이가 강해져야 합니다. 마녀의 삶을 가지고 태어: For our people to survive, this child must grow stronger. How much longer will it take for a child born to a witch's life to become complete...?
strings.(영주의 모습이 모래처럼 흩어져 사라지고 다프네의 주위로 바이스의 형상이: (The lord's figure scatters like sand and vanishes. Weiss' image appears beside Daphne. Their words continue on separate subjects, never quite forming a conversation.)
strings.순수한 영혼을 가진 칼리 족의 힘이 필요해. 위약자여, 날 방해하지 말아: I need the power of the Kali tribe's pure souls. Do not stand in my way, Oathbreaker!!
strings.순간적으로 당신을 도운 과오를 범했지만, 당신의 뜻대론 되지 않을 것입니: I made the mistake of helping you for a moment, but things will not go as you wish.
strings.어떻게 알고 과거의 신이 코랄시티를 봉인했군. 어리석은 어인의 왕을 이용: Somehow the former god learned of it and sealed Coral City. I could have used that foolish fishman king...
Still, this will do. With this much life force, and that of the Kali tribe...
My precious child, as dear as my own soul, as though you were part of me.
strings.위약자여…. 그건 계약에 없던 일인데, 왜 다프네를 죽이지 못하게 하는: Oathbreaker... That was not in our contract. Why will you not let me kill Daphne?
Because that is what the one I serve wishes.
strings.방해가 되는 존재…, 죽이지 못한다면 차라리 시공간의 틈으로 떨어뜨리는: An obstacle... If I cannot kill her, I must cast her into the rift between time and space...
strings.칼리 족일 수도 있고…, 아닐 수도 있는 생명의 힘이 담긴 마석. 네가: A magic stone filled with life force that may or may not belong to the Kali tribe. Why do you need it...?
Medeia... I did not vanish because I wanted to... Medea...
It seems Daphne intended us to see that.
strings.다시 호숫가 앞으로 가실까요?: Shall we return to the lakeside?
Now that I understand everything, I'll collect my thoughts and explain.
strings.(메디아가 걱정하지 말라는 것처럼 작은 미소를 보이며 먼저 걸어나간다.): (With a faint smile as if to reassure you, Medea walks ahead.)
To you as well as me, Lady Jenna...
I've put my thoughts in some order. Let me explain now.
strings.(메디아가 환영의 눈물을 바닥에 떨어뜨린다. 그대로 세차게 내려진 지팡이: (Medea drops the Tear of Illusion. Her staff strikes down hard, shattering the vessel of Daphne's memories.)
strings.이건 필요 없습니다. 이제 제 존재를 알 것 같으니까요. 이번이 몇 번째: I no longer need this. I think I understand what I am now. Though I cannot say how many lives I have lived...
strings.칼리 일족은 다른 인간들에 비해 깨끗한 영혼을 가지고 있습니다. 바이스가: The Kali tribe's souls are purer than those of other humans. Pure enough to form the foundation of Weiss' magic stones...
strings.그분은 일족을 지키고자 하면서 일족을 도운 영주님께 마녀란 사실을 들켰던: She wanted to protect our people, but when the lord who had helped us discovered she was a witch, she made a terrible mistake.
strings.일족이 인간이란 걸 강조하면서도…. 스스로 인간을 버린 채 '마녀'의 삶: Even as she insisted that our people were human... she abandoned her own humanity and chose a witch's life...
Then, in the name of protecting our people, she struck a bargain with Weiss.
strings.영주 님을 비롯해 지스카드 님과 제나 님…. 그리고 영지의 모든 생명에게: She did terrible things to the lord, to Lord Ziskad and Lady Jenna... and to every living being on the estate. I am sorry.
That was not your fault, Lady Medea.
But I think I was part of the reason she did it...
strings.(메디아가 고개를 들어 살며시 하늘을 바라본다.): (Medea raises her head and quietly looks at the sky.)
strings.제가 처음으로 태어났을 때가 언제인지 모르겠지만…. 저는 열두 살에 죽었: I don't know when I was first born... But I died when I was twelve. Many other Kali children died as I did.
Children were born only to die, and those still living suffered Weiss' attacks... As a last resort, she made a deal with him...
If she dealt with the Zisk estate, he would give her magic stones brimming with life force...
strings.그래서 죽어가던 아이들의 일부가 살아남았습니다. 그분께선 그 과정에서 제: Some of the dying children survived as a result. In the process, she discovered that I was destined to become a witch.
strings.마녀로 각성해서 옆에 있길 바라신 건지, 아니면 다른 걸 원하신 건지는: I don't know if she wanted me to awaken as a witch and remain at her side, or if she wanted something else.
strings.마석의 영향으로, 생명의 힘으로 아이들은 점차 살 수 있었습니다. 하지만: With the stones' power, their life force, the children gradually became able to live. But Beinan and I alone kept dying and awakening again...
strings.저와 베이넌의 기억은 삭제됐습니다…. 새로운 삶을 부여받을 때마다 전 그: Our memories were erased... Each time I was given a new life, I believed it was all there was. She must have thought it was for the best.
strings.그 당시 마을 어른들께선 어렴풋이 알고 있었습니다. 제가 왜 살아야 했는: The village elders had some idea back then. Why I had to live... Why she kept bringing me back...
Then she disappeared. Perhaps Weiss sent her somewhere...
strings.지도자가 사라진 일족은 데이모스 교단의 습격을 받았고, 그 상황에서 최후: With our leader gone, the Deimos Order attacked us. In that crisis, our people made a final choice, unaware that it was the wrong one...
strings.어른들이 저를 살리기 위해, 제가 일족을 지켜줄거라는 믿음으로 칼리 마을: To save me, believing I would protect the tribe, the elders threw themselves into the vortex of mana that guarded Kali Village.
strings.(메디아가 올라오는 감정을 이기지 못했는지 흐느끼기를 반복한다. 모험가와: (Overcome by emotion, Medea begins to sob. The adventurer and Jenna comfort her and wait.)
strings.죄송합니다…. 저 잠깐 누워있어도 될까요?: I'm sorry... May I lie down for a moment?
Lady Medea, please rest, as Jenna says.
strings.(제나가 누워있는 메디아의 상태를 걱정스러운 눈빛으로 확인한다.): (Jenna watches the resting Medea with concern.)
strings.분명 감정을 다스릴 때 좋은 게 있었는데…. 아!: There was something good for calming the emotions... Oh!
strings.%s 님, 저희 영지에서 블루베리를 좀 찾아주시겠어요?: %s, could you find some blueberries on our estate?
strings.지스크 블루베리가 심신을 안정시키는데 도움이 많이 되거든요. 알게아들을: Zisk Blueberries are very soothing for both body and mind. Chase away the Algea and you should find some easily.
strings.모험가님, 오셨군요. 블루베리는 있던가요?: You're back, Adventurer. Were there any blueberries?
strings.네, 알게아들이 있는 곳에 좀 남아있었어요. 메디아 님, 이제 좀 진정이: Yes. There were some left where the Algea were. Lady Medea, these should help you feel calmer.
(You bring a richly purple blueberry to Medea's lips. Its sweet fragrance draws her eyes open.)
strings.(메디아가 조심스레 블루베리의 맛을 본 후, %s에게 손을 내민다.): (After carefully tasting the blueberry, Medea reaches a hand toward %s.)
strings.저기 메디아 님, 괜찮으세요?: Lady Medea, are you all right?
Blueberries from the Zisk Plains... They taste just like the ones we harvested in Kali. Perhaps they were grown here as part of our exchange...
strings.아, 저도 기억이 나요. 어릴 때, 농부님들이 새로운 열매라면서 좋아하셨: Oh, I remember too. When I was little, the farmers were delighted with a new kind of fruit.
strings.좋은 관계가 될 수도 있었던 사이가 무너진 걸 생각하면 가슴이 아프군요…: It hurts to think how a relationship with such promise was destroyed... Though the estate's blueberries are a little sweeter.
They would make a liquor Lord Ziskad would enjoy... Hehe...
strings.기운을 차리셔서 다행이에요. 조금 더 쉬시겠어요?: I'm glad you're feeling better. Would you like to rest a little more?
strings.…아닙니다. 제가 알던 사실을 계속 이야기해야 이리스 님도, 지스카드 님: ...No. I must finish telling what I know, so Lady Iris and Lord Ziskad can understand as well.
Please don't look at me like that. This is a story I must tell...
strings.아, 어르신들…. 전 스스로 생명의 힘으로 돌아가신 분들의 힘을 받아: Ah, the elders... With the power of those who willingly returned themselves to life force, I was able to protect some of our people, including the young children.
strings.그 과정은 마석의 힘을 빌려 약간의 수명을 연장받았던 저를 다시 죽음으로: In doing so, I was led back toward death. The magic stones had only prolonged my life a little...
Her sins, and the memories of certain others... Perhaps of witches...
strings.그때, 저는 다시 살 수 있었습니다. 죽지 않았습니다. 나중에 알게 됐지: At that moment, I was able to live again. I did not die. I learned later that it was the blessing of Lady Gaia, who had awakened then.
strings.그분을 비롯해서 저도 몰랐던 운명…. 제가 그때부터 마녀와 초인의 삶을: A fate neither she nor I had known... That from then on I would live as both witch and Champion...
strings.말씀드리지 못한 게 있는데, 저는 이번 일로 제가 가이아 님께 받은 신의: There is something I haven't told you. During these events, I gave Lady Iris the divine power I had received from Lady Gaia. For her sake...
strings.그렇다고 해서 마녀의 삶을 살지는 않을 것입니다. 신을 향한 제 신뢰는: That does not mean I will live as a witch. My trust in the divine will only grow stronger. Lady Iris will watch over me...
strings.더는 이 땅에 저를 비롯한 비슷한 운명들의 초인이 나타나지 않아야 하니까: No more Champions with fates like mine should have to appear in this land...
strings.괜찮습니다. 제게 있던 그 죽음의 저주는 이미 벗어났으니까요. 샤이닉이: It's all right. I have already escaped that curse of death, through the power of Perse that Shynic shared with me... And that is the end of my story.
strings.아니에요. 덕분에 제 기억에도 도움이 됐어요. 저를 위해, 오라버니를: Not at all. You've helped me understand my own memories, too. Thank you for telling us, for my sake and my brother's.
strings.(초인들은 다 이런 운명이었는데…. 이제 정말 괜찮아지는 걸까…? 아직: (The Champions all bore such fates... Will things really be all right now? Lady Medea still has...)
Lady Medea... I wish I could hug you, but with this body...
strings.안아주시는 대신 노래를 불러주시겠어요? 지스카드 님께서 우리 제나가 말이: Then would you sing for me instead? Lord Ziskad kept boasting about 'our Jenna.' I've wanted to hear you.
strings.아, 오라버니께서…. 저 자랑할 만한 실력은 아니지만…. 연습한 곡이 있: Oh, my brother... I'm not that good, but... I have a song I've been practicing. I'll sing it for you.
I'd love to hear it too, Jenna.
strings.(제나가 환한 얼굴로 고개를 끄덕인다. 이어 눈을 감고 호흡을 가다듬는다: (Jenna nods with a radiant smile, then closes her eyes and steadies her breathing.)
strings.계속 바라고 또 바라던 같은 하늘 아래…♬: Beneath the same sky, as I wished and wished... ♬
strings.(모두의 행복을 바라는 제나의 노래가 이어진다. 메디아가 품고 있던 불안: (Jenna's song continues, wishing happiness for everyone. Little by little, the unease in Medea's heart flows away into the Lake of Oblivion.)
